newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank, Sussex file plan for Pic 'N Pay.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank, Sussex file plan for Pic 'N Pay.

text.p: NationsBank N.A. and Sussex Holdings Inc, a private investor group led by William Taggart, said on Tuesday that they have jointly filed a consensual reorganization plan and disclosure statement for Pic 'N Pay Stores Inc.
NationsBank is the largest creditor for Pic 'N Pay, which filed for Chapter 11 February 15. Sussex owns all of the equity of the footwear and accessory retailer.

The U.S Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware has scheduled a November 15 hearing to review the disclosure statement. NationsBank and Sussex said Pic 'N Pay hopes to emerge from Chapter 11 by year-end.
Since filing for Chapter 11 Pic 'N Pay has closed more than 250 underperforming stores, NationsBank and Sussex said.
